text: dsh-revdiff 是面向 DeepSeek Harness TUI 的原生交互式 Git 差异审查插件。它注册 `/revdiff` 命令，通过受管理的 Git 子进程读取工作区差异，并在终端中按文件、区块和行浏览。用户可以为代码行添加、编辑或删除问题、建议、提问和赞赏批注，再将带文件与行号信息的结构化反馈提交给当前 Agent。支持审查暂存、未暂存或指定基准版本的已跟踪文本改动，也可按路径筛选；运行需要 Harness 进程拥有交互终端，并在同一环境提供 Git。

dsh-revdiff adds interactive Git diff review to the DeepSeek Harness TUI. Run `/revdiff` to browse tracked changes by file and line, including staged, unstaged, or base-revision changes. Add structured line comments and send them to the current Agent. Requires Git and an interactive terminal.

能不能把代码审查意见按具体文件行发回当前 Agent？
我需要只看暂存区里的差异并逐行做批注。
想对比工作区和某个 Git 基准版本，再筛选指定路径。
有没有办法在终端里给 diff 行添加问题或建议？
我想浏览多个文件和差异区块，并给选中的行写评论。
I want to review staged and unstaged Git changes inside the Harness terminal.
How can I send line-specific review comments back to the current agent session?
dsh-revdiff 的功能「交互式差异审查」：运行 `/revdiff` 后读取 Git 已跟踪改动，并在全屏终端中按行、区块和文件导航；可选择暂存、未暂存或基准版本，并限定路径。
dsh-revdiff 的功能「结构化行批注」：在选中的差异行添加、修改或删除问题、建议、提问、赞赏，批注保留文件、旧新侧、行号和代码内容。
dsh-revdiff 的功能「提交审查反馈」：按下提交键后，将非空批注整理为带插件来源信息的文本消息，并通过 Agent followup 送回当前 Harness 会话。
dsh-revdiff 使用前须知：交互审查要求 Harness 进程拥有 TTY 终端，且 Git 必须能在 Harness 同一执行环境中调用；非交互终端会返回错误。见 src/index.ts:45-48。

dsh-revdiff README · dsh-revdiff：Native interactive diff review for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). The plugin reads a Git unified diff, parses it into files, hunks, and line locations, presents its own terminal review interface, and queues submitted annotations as the Agent's next durable follow-up turn.

dsh-revdiff README · Why this exists 💡：Reviewing a diff in a separate tool breaks the connection between the change, the review context, and the Agent that will act on the feedback. `dsh-revdiff` keeps review inside Harness, so annotations are created against the actual Git diff and returned to the same durable session.

dsh-revdiff README · Features ✨：- Review tracked working-tree, staged, unstaged, or base-revision changes with optional path filters.
- Navigate between files, hunks, and diff lines from an interactive terminal.
- Add, edit, and delete issue, suggestion, question, or praise annotations.
- Submit structured annotations to the current Agent through `agent.followup()` with message provenance.
- Configure Git execution, diff context, size and time limits, terminal grace period, and comment length.

dsh-revdiff README · Install 📦：Add this checkout to a Harness profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile demo add ./dsh-revdiff
```

The only external runtime requirement is Git in the same execution world as Harness.

dsh-revdiff README · Use 🚀：```text
/revdiff
/revdiff --staged
/revdiff --unstaged
/revdiff main

The default reviews all tracked working-tree changes against `HEAD`, including staged and unstaged changes. `--staged` reviews the index, `--unstaged` reviews only worktree changes relative to the index, and a base revision reviews the working tree against that revision. Put path filters after `--`.

The Harness process must own an interactive terminal. The review interface supports:

dsh-revdiff README · Use 🚀：- `↑`/`↓` or `k`/`j`: move between diff lines
- `n`/`p`: move between hunks
- `]`/`[` or `→`/`←`: move between files
- `a`: add an issue, suggestion, question, or praise annotation
- `e`: edit the selected line's annotation
- `d`: delete the selected line's annotation
- `s`: submit annotations to the current Agent
- `q`, Escape, or Ctrl-C: cancel without sending a message

dsh-revdiff README · Use 🚀：Annotations retain the file, old/new side, line number, selected code, kind, and comment. They are sent through `agent.followup()` with `dsh-revdiff` message provenance, so the review enters the same Harness session rather than an external side channel.

dsh-revdiff README · Configure ⚙️：Override the inserted row in a later Harness patch layer:

```yaml
- id: dsh-revdiff
  name: dsh-revdiff
  config:
    gitBinary: git

dsh-revdiff README · Develop 🧑‍💻：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run check
```

Commit the generated `lib/` files with source changes so Git installs include the declared package entry before build scripts run.

dsh-revdiff README · Scope 🎯：Version 0.1 reviews textual changes already represented by `git diff`. Untracked files, binary patches, side-by-side rendering, mouse input, and a browser-hosted review surface are not included yet. The review engine and annotation model are owned by this project so those capabilities can evolve for Harness without following another review tool's interface.

dsh-revdiff README · Credits 🙏：The product idea is informed by [`pi-diff-review`](https://github.com/badlogic/pi-diff-review) and [`revdiff`](https://github.com/umputun/revdiff), but this is an independent implementation built specifically around Harness commands, managed subprocesses, Agent lifecycle, and message provenance. It does not install, execute, wrap, or parse output from `revdiff`.
